mapper.select: select v.id, v.title, v.description, v.cover_url, v.video_url, v.duration, v.user_id, v.category_id, v.status, v.view_count, v.like_count, v.comment_count, v.share_count, v.create_time, v.update_time, u.nickname, u.avatar from video v left join user u on v.user_id = u.id where v.status = 1 order by rand()
